principles.statement: Report the observation, not the inference.
principles.note: 'The service is active and returned OK' can be verified by a reader. 'It works' cannot.

principles.statement: Silence is not evidence of success.
principles.note: A process that hangs, a branch that logs nothing, and a command that was never reached all produce the same empty output as a clean run.

principles.statement: Check whether you are inside what you are measuring.
principles.note: Searches that match themselves and teardowns that destroy their own host are the same error: the observer was part of the sample.

symptoms.symptom: The page renders blank
symptoms.note: Nothing visible, but the DOM may be complete and merely invisible.

symptoms.symptom: The deploy ran but nothing changed
symptoms.note: The new code is on disk. Something between disk and user is still serving the old one.

symptoms.symptom: The command succeeded but had no effect
symptoms.note: Exit zero describes the process, not the outcome you wanted.

symptoms.symptom: The service says active but is not working
symptoms.note: Active is a statement about a process existing, not about it serving.

symptoms.symptom: An animation or counter never moves
symptoms.note: Frozen at frame zero is indistinguishable from correctly static.

symptoms.symptom: The tests pass but the feature is broken
symptoms.note: A test that never ran, and a test that asserts nothing, both report green.

symptoms.symptom: The API returned 200 but the data is wrong
symptoms.note: The status describes the transaction, not the payload.

symptoms.symptom: My config change is being ignored
symptoms.note: The file records intent. Something later, or something else, decided the outcome.

symptoms.symptom: The logs show nothing useful
symptoms.note: Silence is produced by a filter, a rotation and a crash alike.

symptoms.symptom: A process died and I cannot tell why
symptoms.note: The thing that was killed is often not the thing that caused it.

symptoms.symptom: A URL returns 200 for something that does not exist
symptoms.note: A catch-all answered on the origin's behalf.

symptoms.symptom: Clicks land on nothing
symptoms.note: The element you can see is not the element receiving the event.

symptoms.symptom: The wrong file or image was used
symptoms.note: A plausible artifact of the right type is not evidence it is the right one.

symptoms.symptom: Text renders, but it looks wrong
symptoms.note: A substitution that still renders is invisible without a comparison.

symptoms.symptom: Assets take seconds to appear
symptoms.note: Late departure and slow transfer feel identical from the viewport.

symptoms.symptom: Numbers come back subtly altered
symptoms.note: Silent coercion produces a valid value that is not your value.

symptoms.symptom: A search for a process finds something unexpected
symptoms.note: The instrument is a process, and it is inside its own sample.

symptoms.symptom: A command hangs and never returns
symptoms.note: There is no exit code to read, and silence resembles progress.

symptoms.symptom: Log lines are in an impossible order
symptoms.note: Two streams with different buffering do not interleave the way they were written.

symptoms.symptom: Credentials are ignored but the request still succeeds
symptoms.note: Something in the chain dropped the header and the endpoint answered anyway.

symptoms.symptom: A fresh clone is missing files that are present locally
symptoms.note: Committed is not the same as tracked.

symptoms.symptom: The screenshot does not match what I see in a browser
symptoms.note: A capture is taken under its own device scale, colour scheme and stylesheet, not yours.

symptoms.symptom: A downloaded file is not the content I expected
symptoms.note: The transfer succeeded; the encoding or the destination path did not.

symptoms.symptom: The machine looks busy but nothing is progressing
symptoms.note: Load and CPU percentages measure different things than they appear to.

symptoms.symptom: A file I edited lost its contents
symptoms.note: The shell truncates a redirect target before the command reading it ever starts.

symptoms.symptom: The process ran out of memory but the box has plenty
symptoms.note: A container sees the host's totals, not its own limit.

symptoms.symptom: My analytics and my server logs disagree
symptoms.note: One of them is counting what clients claim to be, and clients set that field themselves.

symptoms.symptom: A shell variable was empty and nothing complained
symptoms.note: Several builtins treat an empty argument as a request to do nothing, successfully.

symptoms.symptom: curl and my HTTP library disagree about the same response
symptoms.note: Header collapsing, protocol version and informational status lines differ per client.

symptoms.symptom: grep finds nothing in a header dump that clearly contains it
symptoms.note: HTTP/2 lowercases every field name; an anchored pattern matches neither case.

symptoms.symptom: Nobody can find the thing I published
symptoms.note: Being fetched, being indexed and being findable are three different states.

recipes.when: Files copied to a web root, or pushed to a host that serves them.

steps.check: Hash the served bytes against the file on disk, from a client that has never requested the URL.
steps.how: curl -s https://HOST/path | md5sum   # compare to md5sum of the local file

steps.check: Check which layer answered, not just that something did.
steps.how: curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'code=%{http_code} remote=%{remote_ip} age=%header{age}\n' URL

steps.check: Request a path that should not exist. A catch-all will answer 200 for it.
steps.how: curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://HOST/definitely-not-here

steps.check: Confirm the copy landed where you meant, not one directory deeper.
steps.how: ls the destination; rsync without a trailing slash nests the source directory

steps.check: Fetch as a client would, following redirects and decompressing.
steps.how: curl -sL --compressed --fail URL | head

steps.check: Confirm the page can be found, not merely fetched.
steps.how: Search an exact phrase from the page in quotes; crawler hits in your log prove nothing about the index.

recipes.when: A systemd unit, container or daemon was reloaded to pick up new code or config.

steps.check: Compare the unit's ExecStart on disk against the live process.
steps.how: systemctl show -p ExecStart -p MainPID UNIT && ps -p $MAINPID -o args=

steps.check: Confirm the binary the process is executing is the one you replaced.
steps.how: stat -Lc %i /proc/$MAINPID/exe   # against stat -c %i /path/to/binary

steps.check: Ask the socket, not the manager. Type=simple is active before execve.
steps.how: ss -ltnp 'sport = :PORT'

steps.check: Check it is not crash-looping between your observations.
steps.how: systemctl show -p NRestarts -p ExecMainStartTimestamp UNIT

steps.check: Ask the running service what config it loaded, not the filesystem what it holds.
steps.how: For Caddy: the admin API's live config. For sshd: sshd -T as root.

steps.check: Confirm the unit's workers stopped, not just the unit.
steps.how: systemctl show -p KillMode UNIT; then ps for the children by name

recipes.when: A config, stylesheet, env file or manifest was edited.

steps.check: Read the resolved value, never the authored one.
steps.how: getComputedStyle(el).prop for CSS; sshd -T for sshd; the service's own live config otherwise

steps.check: Check nothing later in the file, or in an include, overrides it.
steps.how: Search the whole merged configuration for every occurrence of the key, not just yours.

steps.check: Check the parser agrees with you about types.
steps.how: python3 -c "import yaml,sys;[print(repr(k),repr(v),type(v).__name__) for k,v in yaml.safe_load(open(sys.argv[1])).items()]" FILE

steps.check: Make invisible characters visible before trusting a value.
steps.how: cat -A FILE   # CRLF shows as ^M$

steps.check: Confirm the file is actually tracked, and is the one being served.
steps.how: git status --short --ignored && git ls-files --error-unmatch FILE

steps.check: Confirm in-place edits followed the symlink instead of replacing it.
steps.how: stat -c '%i %F' FILE before and after; sed -i needs --follow-symlinks

recipes.task: I checked that a page renders correctly
recipes.when: A screenshot, headless capture or visual review was used to judge a page.

steps.check: Confirm the animation loop runs at all before judging any frame.
steps.how: let n=0; requestAnimationFrame(()=>n++); setTimeout(()=>console.log('rAF fired:', n), 1000)

steps.check: Capture console errors. Inert and wrong look identical in an image.
steps.how: Collect page errors during load; an element that never initialised renders nothing.

steps.check: Check the fonts you designed against actually loaded.
steps.how: document.fonts.check('1em "Family Name"')

steps.check: Compare element count against visible count.
steps.how: document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').length vs those with computed opacity above zero

steps.check: Confirm the capture used your device scale, colour scheme and stylesheet.
steps.how: devicePixelRatio, matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches, and print vs screen media

steps.check: Wait for data, not for the load event.
steps.how: The load event fires before fetched content arrives; assert on the rendered rows.

steps.check: Compare a viewport capture against a full-page one before trusting either.
steps.how: A full-page capture flattens fixed elements and can skip content-visibility sections.

steps.check: Check for frames that resolved but were refused.
steps.how: performance.getEntriesByType('resource') — a refused frame has transferSize 0

recipes.task: I ran the test suite and it passed

steps.check: Confirm the tests you think exist were actually collected.
steps.how: pytest --collect-only -q | tail -1   # compare the count against what you expect

steps.check: Confirm the mocks still resemble the objects they stand in for.
steps.how: create_autospec(Real) raises on a method the real object no longer has; a bare Mock() does not.

steps.check: Check the exit status came from the runner, not from a later command in the pipe.
steps.how: set -o pipefail, or read ${PIPESTATUS[@]}

steps.check: Check nothing swallowed a failure inside a loop.
steps.how: find -exec returns find's status, not the command's; use -print0 | xargs -0

recipes.task: I ran a script or pipeline
recipes.when: A shell script, CI step or command pipeline completed.

steps.check: Read the status of the command you care about, not the last one.
steps.how: set -o pipefail; or echo ${PIPESTATUS[@]}

steps.check: Confirm it did not exit early on an unrelated precondition.
steps.how: Under set -e a global validation step aborts before the step you wanted.

steps.check: Confirm every child's status was collected.
steps.how: wait $pid per child; bare wait returns 0 regardless

steps.check: Confirm it returned at all rather than waiting on a prompt.
steps.how: sudo -n true returns non-zero immediately when a password would be needed; wrap in timeout

steps.check: Check redirections point where you think.
steps.how: cmd >f 2>&1 sends both to f; cmd 2>&1 >f does not

steps.check: Confirm it did not tear down the environment it was running inside.
steps.how: Compare the teardown target against $TMUX, the current container, the host you are on.

steps.check: Refuse empty path variables rather than letting a builtin succeed on nothing.
steps.how: : "${DIR:?DIR is empty}"; cd "$DIR" && [ "$PWD" = "$DIR" ]

steps.check: Split declaration from assignment so the status survives.
steps.how: local out; out=$(cmd)   # local out=$(cmd) always returns 0

recipes.task: I fetched or scraped a resource
recipes.when: A URL was downloaded, an API called, or a page parsed.

steps.check: Check the status code came with a body worth having.
steps.how: curl -sS --fail --compressed URL >out; echo $?   # 22 on 4xx/5xx, 18 on truncation

steps.check: Parse the body even on 200. Some APIs report failure inside a success.
steps.how: Look for an errors array, an Error root element, or unprocessed items.

steps.check: Check whether a cache answered.
steps.how: curl -sI URL | grep -iE '^(age|x-cache|cf-cache-status):'

steps.check: Prefer the canonical marker the document declares over any heuristic ranking.
steps.how: og:image, rel=canonical, structured data — not 'the largest image on the page'

steps.check: Confirm credentials survived any redirect.
steps.how: curl -v shows the Authorization header dropped on a cross-origin hop.

steps.check: Check large integers survived the parse.
steps.how: Round-trip the value; anything above 2^53 loses precision in a double.

steps.check: Compare the bytes received against the declared length.
steps.how: curl -sS -o body -w 'declared=%{size_download}\n' URL && wc -c < body

steps.check: Read the final status, not the first status line.
steps.how: curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' URL   # a 103 can precede the answer

recipes.task: I read the logs and saw no errors
recipes.when: Log output, journal or stdout was inspected for errors.

steps.check: Confirm the level you filtered on is the level the app writes.
steps.how: journalctl -u UNIT -o json | jq -r .PRIORITY | sort | uniq -c

steps.check: Confirm logging was configured before the first record.
steps.how: logging.basicConfig is a no-op once a handler exists; pass force=True

steps.check: Check nothing was dropped by rate limiting or rotation.
steps.how: Look for suppression notices; check the daemon is not writing to a deleted inode.

steps.check: Check output was flushed rather than lost with the process.
steps.how: A killed process discards unflushed stdout; run with unbuffered output.

steps.check: Check the journal survives a reboot before relying on it.
steps.how: journalctl --list-boots; /var/log/journal must exist for persistence

recipes.task: The machine is slow, or something ran out of memory
recipes.when: Memory, CPU or load average was inspected to explain slowness, a stall, or a container or process being OOM killed.

steps.check: Read the cgroup's limit, not the host's totals.
steps.how: cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max and memory.events   # free(1) is not scoped to the cgroup

steps.check: Rank every process by footprint, not just the one that died.
steps.how: ps -eo rss,comm --sort=-rss | head -20   # count anything spawned in a loop

steps.check: Check whether load is CPU work or uninterruptible sleep.
steps.how: ps -eo state= | sort | uniq -c   # D means blocked on I/O, not running

steps.check: Sample CPU over an interval rather than reading a lifetime average.
steps.how: Compare /proc/PID/stat utime+stime across a few seconds

steps.check: Resolve a PID before killing anything matched by pattern.
steps.how: pgrep -af PATTERN and read it; your own command matches too

recipes.task: I published a package or release
recipes.when: An artifact was uploaded to a registry, or a release was cut.

steps.check: Install the published artifact from the real index, in a clean environment.
steps.how: uvx --refresh-package NAME --from NAME==VERSION NAME   # never test the local build

steps.check: Confirm the index you queried is not a stale cache.
steps.how: A resolver holding an old index reports a published version as missing.

steps.check: Confirm the tests actually gated the publish.
steps.how: Chaining commands is not a gate; only a non-zero exit that stops the script is.

steps.check: Confirm bundled copies match their source.
steps.how: diff -q every vendored copy against the original; copies drift silently.
